div.head: Abt 81
div.ab: Gif hio bearn ne gebyreþ, fæderingmagas fioh agan ⁊ morgengyfe.
Gif hio bearn ne gebyreþ, fæderingmagas fioh agan ⁊ morgengyfe.
If she does not bear a child, her paternal kin should obtain [her] property and the morning-gift.
If she does not bear a child, [her] father’s relatives shall have her goods, and the “morning gift.”
If she does not bear a child, [her] paternal kinsmen are to have [her] goods and the “morning-gift”.
Wenn sie Nachkommenschaft nicht gebiert, erhalten [bei Auflösung der Ehe ihre] Vatersippen [das] Gut [der Frau] und [die vom Manne ihr bei der Hochzeit gegebene] Morgengabe.
If she does not bear offspring, [on the dissolution of the marriage her] paternal kin receive [the woman’s] property and the morning-gift [given her by the husband at the wedding].
div.note: The gift made by the husband to the bride the morning after the consummation of the marriage.
